text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can produce art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These programs learn from huge amounts of data created by humans and then generate new content in seconds. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. People create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination, while AI simply recognises patterns and follows instructions. AI can be a useful helper for artists and writers, but it cannot truly feel or understand what it makes. For now, the best results often come when humans and machines work together.
